text:
maria: quick sketch: split routing into 'edge fast-path' + 'policy slow-path' and add a three-tier cache (edge/regional/global) to reduce p50/p95 without changing policy semantics

sam: what do you mean by unchanged semantics? cache could violate constraints if stale

maria: we enforce tenant constraints in the cache key and only serve cached entries if bitmap constraints match. semantics preserved for constraint checks; cache only optimizes stable decisions.

leo: ok, what lives in edge vs policy?

maria: edge: deterministic heuristics, cache lookup, immediate hedging on failure. policy: full scoring/constraint solve and token/invalidations. Edge returns cache hit; else calls policy.

amy: cache key format? we need deterministic libs for all langs

maria: key := tenant_id + "|" + route_id + "|" + model_version + "|" + constraint_bitmap + "|" + input_prefix_hash(256)
edge_ttl ~ 300ms, regional_ttl ~ 45s, global_ttl ~ 5m

devon: how do we invalidate when capacity changes or model rollouts happen?

maria: two mechanisms: 1) incremental invalidation token published by policy via control channel, entries stamped with token; 2) passive: on 429/503 we mark key suspect and refresh.

sam: distribution cost of tokens? sounds chatty

maria: tiny pub/sub messages with route scope, reuse existing control channel. avg <1 msg/s per region. messages are compact (route ids + token#).

leo: race conditions if token arrives just after edge serves a cached entry

maria: acceptable window: entries are short TTL (300ms) at edge. tokens bump must be processed within 1s ideally; hedging on passive failures handles misses.

amy: what's input_prefix_hash? hashing first N chars changes semantics for long prompts

maria: use prefix only to avoid explosion of keys; prefix size is configurable (256/1024). fallback to policy for full-hash mismatch cases flagged by policy during canary.

sam: telemetry to validate correctness?

maria: emit for every cache event: tenant_id, route_id, cache_tier, token_id, cache_key_hash, hit_latency, outcome(served/hedged/invalidated), policy_decision_id if mismatch. On mismatch log full decision chain.

devon: canary plan?

maria: shadow for 24h (log diffs), then 1% traffic using cached returns with full telemetry, rollback if mismatch >0.1% or 5xx/429 delta +0.5% vs baseline. increase to 10% then 50% gradually.

leo: multi-tenant fairness? noisy tenants could poison edge LRU

maria: soft per-tenant quotas in edge LRU and admission reservations. regional cache + policy still enforces fairness on fallback.

amy: operator ergonomics: runbook for invalidation and emergency flush?

maria: snippet in RFC:
```
# flush route globally
curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/invalidate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"route_id":"R123"}'
# returns token id and propagation ack_count
```

devon: any API changes on policy side?

maria: minimal: /policy/resolve?shadow=true returns decision without side-effects; /policy/invalidate can be called by controlplane or tooling. pubsub is primary. Backwards compatible.

sam: implementation note: key generation must be in shared lib for go/python/rust

maria: agreed. small packages per language.

leo: edge versioning compatibility? some edges might not understand tokens during rollout

maria: cache entries include min_edge_version; older edges bypass cache and hit policy. new edges only serve cached entries when token matches.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: feature-flag `edge_routing_cache` enabled in staging. schedule: Tue 00:30 UTC canary start.

sam: ok i'll start RFC addendum w/ diagrams, sam/leo can own canonical key lib. maria please add telemetry schema and canary checklist.

maria: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:
